    Steve Sarkisian
     is the head football coach for the University of Texas Longhorns, a position he has held since 2021. Under his leadership, the team has achieved high rankings, including CFP appearances, and transitioned into the SEC. He is known for building a strong offensive program and developing high-level running backs. 
    • Contract/Background: Sarkisian, often called "Coach Sark," has a multi-year contract with Texas that included a guaranteed
      million over six years.
    • Recent Staff Changes: As of early 2026, reports indicate Will Muschamp was hired to lead the defense after the team moved on from Pete Kwiatkowski, aiming to secure national championships.
    • Coaching Staff Highlights:
      The staff includes key coaches such as Jeff Banks (Special Teams/TE) and Kenny Baker (Defensive Line).
    • Accomplishments: He has led Texas to multiple bowl games and was named to the Bear Bryant Coach of the Year Award watch list in 2024. 
    Sarkisian's focus remains on competing for SEC and National Championships.

    Steve Sarkisian is married to Loreal Sarkisian (formerly Smith), a former collegiate track star, professional track athlete, and coach. Married in 2020, she is known as the "first lady of Texas football" and has gained attention for her fashion-forward game-day outfits and her styling business. They welcomed their first child together in April 2025, according to ESPN. 
    Key Facts About Loreal Sarkisian: 
    • Career: A former track star and coach.
    • Fashion: Known for her unique game day outfits and personal styling business.
    • Philanthropy: Involved in supporting the local Austin and UT community, focusing on helping women and children
      .
    • Family: She is the wife of Texas Head Coach Steve Sarkisian and they welcomed a child together in 2025.
    • Background: She grew up in a hardworking family, with a creative mother who often made her clothes. 
    Note: Steve Sarkisian was previously married to Stephanie Sarkisian until 2016.
